headline: Nikita Kucherov explains trade request: Lightning 'made it clear that I’m free to walk on July 1'
take:
The Athletic reports that Nikita Kucherov has explained his trade request, saying the Lightning "made it clear that I'm free to walk on July 1," and one GM told the outlet that "31 teams" would try to land him if he becomes available. The Hockey News adds that he cited poor communication and respect, and that Shane Wright has been traded from the Kraken to the Predators.

Our numbers say Kucherov is still the player teams are lining up for. He has 20 points in 15 games so far this season, and the Lightning take 58% of the expected goals (the quality of chances) in his five-on-five minutes. Tampa Bay's share of those chances is about 4 percentage points better with him on the ice. His four goals sit just under what his chances predict (4.95 expected), so there is no sign of a lucky start. Wright is a different case. He has 4 points in 16 games so far this season, and the Kraken's share of chances at five-on-five is lower with him on the ice (47%) than the team's overall mark. Nashville gets a former fourth-overall pick still searching for his level, in limited minutes at 14.1 a game.
